name: Yanxiao's Crazy Kitchen
description: Smiley Yanxiao from Wangshu Inn seems to be struggling with his workload during the Lantern Rite...

steps.description: Talk to Smiley Yanxiao at night (19:00 – 23:00)
Serve dishes to Holderlin and Caspar
Deliver the food to Aunt Qiao
Deliver the food to Aunt Qiao
Serve dishes to Holderlin and Caspar
Procure 3 portions of Tofu, Almonds, and Rice
Give a Xiao Lantern to Smiley Yanxiao
Give a Xiao Lantern to Jiangxue

dialogs.content: This is bad...
Something the matter?
Lantern Rite's the matter, what else? We've had lots of staff head back to the city to spend the festive period there, so we've got our hands full right now.
Haven't the time for idle chat right now. Need to get ready for the guests' orders at night — doubt I'll even have time to get a sip of water.
If you cared enough to check on me, you might as well help out later tonight.
*sigh* What I'd do for some help right now. Where's that Yuhua run off to...
Argh, I need a rest. My hands are so sore that I can barely lift my wok...
What's wrong?
Ah, Traveler! I was just wondering how nice it'd be if I could have some help. You up for it?
What sort of help...
Most all our staff have headed back to spend the Lantern Rite in the city. We're so short-handed right now that we can barely keep our heads above water, so any help is good help.
You needn't worry, we don't expect you to do any heavy lifting. Just need to help us serve some dishes and gather some ingredients.
Give me a moment, let me see what we can get you to do right now...
Ack, I forgot to take orders from the customers at that table downstairs.
How about this? Go and take orders from those two guests downstairs, Holderlin and Caspar.

They've been waiting for a while now, so they might be getting annoyed. Just remember to bring them <color=#00E1FFFF>two</color> side dishes. Some <color=#00E1FFFF>Delicious Chicken-Mushroom Skewer</color> should do the trick.
After the sides have been served, ask them what they'd like to have for their main course — save yourself that extra trip.
Alright, run along now. Don't keep them waiting.
Ack, I forgot to take orders from the customers at that table downstairs.
How about this? Go and take orders from those two guests downstairs, Holderlin and Caspar.

They've been waiting for a while now, so they might be getting annoyed. Just remember to bring them <color=#00E1FFFF>two</color> side dishes. Some <color=#00E1FFFF>Delicious Chicken-Mushroom Skewer</color> should do the trick.
After the sides have been served, ask them what they'd like to have for their main course — save yourself that extra trip.
Alright, run along now. Don't keep them waiting.
We've been here all day, why hasn't anyone come to take our orders yet?
Well, finally! I was just about to leave...
What would you like to order?
I've heard that the people of Liyue make excellent seafood, so I'd like to try some...
But I've been trying the vegetarian lifestyle out recently, so I can't have meat. I wonder if they have something... vegetarian that tastes like seafood...
Ever since I tried spicy food at Wanmin Restaurant, I've been completely smitten by that flavor. Nowadays, I can't eat anything if it doesn't have that spice in it.
I'll pass on the seafood, I've had too much of it lately. Some fowl would be great.
I'm not too familiar with Liyue cuisine, so I'll take whatever you recommend, thanks.
So, what did they order?
What would Holderlin like to order?
Vegetarian Abalone.
Hmm, that's a tough one. This outlander sure knows how to pick 'em.
What would Caspar like to eat?
Golden Shrimp Balls.
No problem, this won't be hard.
And what would Caspar like to eat?
Jueyun Chili Chicken.
No problem, this won't be hard.
What would Caspar like to eat?
Vegetarian Abalone.
Alright, I've got it.
Golden Shrimp Balls.
Alright, I've got it.
Jueyun Chili Chicken.
This outlander likes spicy food, does he? Ho, I can do that.
Alright, alright, I've got them down now... Phew, this'll be a busy day and no mistake.
Let me see if there's anything we need your help with... Oh yes, we have two servings of takeout here. Could I trouble you to send them out?
One serving of Almond Tofu for Aunt Qiao, and a serving of Golden Shrimp Balls for Zhuyu.
Having made so many dishes in such a short time, we're starting to run out of ingredients.

How about this? While you're on your trip, you bring some ingredients back with you. <color=#00E1FFFF>Three servings of</color> <color=#00E1FFFF>Rice, Almonds, and Tofu</color> each should do the trick.

We really don't have sufficient ingredients on hand right now, so I'll have to trouble you to go out and buy some. You should be able to get all these ingredients from <color=#00E1FFFF>Second Life</color>, just report the bill to me afterwards.
Anything I can do for you, youngster?
Oh? This is... the delivery from Wangshu Inn?
Oh yes, this is wonderful... A serving of Wangshu Inn's Almond Tofu on a festive occasion is always great.
#Thank you, young {M#man}{F#lady}.
Qinglian, is there anything else you'd like to eat other than Golden Shrimp Balls?
*cough* Don't worry. Let's wait a while more, the takeout should be here soon.
Hmm? Do you need anything?
Look, Qinglian, look — our takeout's here! Thanks for making the trip.
You've got some smooth moves, don't you? As expected of an adventurer...
Ah, yes. I've already asked Yuhua to bring the food down to those two customers. They're pretty pleased with it, too — thanks for making that trip.
So, are all the other matters settled?
I've sent those meals out.
Good, good — have you bought the ingredients as well?
What's with that freeloader today...
You've got nimble hands. Thank you, I should be able to send this Xiao Lantern off soon.
Ah, yes — make sure you don't forget to pass the other Xiao Lantern to Jiangxue.
Another year, another Lantern Rite...
A Xiao Lantern? Why so sudden...
Smiley Yanxiao wanted me to send this to you.
Ha, that chef is a thoughtful man indeed. He's... changed a great deal since our initial meeting.
Time slips by, and yet here I am, still unable to wholly let go. How shameful.
What can't you let go of?
Nothing, really. Mere trivial matters that aren't worth any mention. Thanks for coming all this way and sending me that Xiao Lantern.
I don't have anything to wish for, nor have I released a Xiao Lantern of my own in a long time...
But having a lantern by my side to look at isn't too bad. Thank you very much.
Why's that girl Yuhua not in the kitchen helping me out...
Taking orders and sending takeout, buying ingredients, serving the food... What else have we got...
Hope my order arrives soon...
I wonder what I'll be served...
#Thank you, young {M#man}{F#lady}.
Thanks for coming all this way.
Strange — I wonder why those customers don't look too pleased after their dishes arrived.
Did my hand slip somewhere? That can't be...
So, are all the other matters settled?
I've sent those meals out.
Good, good — have you bought the ingredients as well?
Hmm, you were a little slow... *sigh* But there were too many things to do, after all...
Thanks, you've lightened my load a fair bit.
Haha, aren't I a busy man... It's the Lantern Rite, and I haven't put a lantern together yet...
Ah, right. Traveler, do you know how to make Xiao Lanterns?
It doesn't feel right to ask you for help with this as well, but I really can't spare the time to source for materials to make a lantern.
If you're willing to help out, could you make me one... No, two — two lanterns?
I'll take one of them, and I'd like you to help me send the other to Jiangxue. He can usually be found fishing near the inn.
He's usually something of a freeloader, but for some reason, he hasn't come over today...
Come again at night, I need to hurry up and finish making preparations...
